wake_regularity.predicts: Chance of waking close to your usual time (wake-time regularity)
wake_regularity.label: a night counts as regular unless the wake was more than 30 minutes later than the person's own habit (the median of their last 28 nights of the same kind, weekday or weekend; datasets/wake_proxy.py). It says nothing about how the morning went

noLongerPredicted.wakeup_consistency: No real-data target exists for it, so the synthetic model is gone; the app shows your measured sleep consistency instead.

thresholds.from: 75th percentiles of held-out predictions over the evaluation splits

evaluationMethod: Grouped by participant: 8 splits, 20% of people held out each time, never seen in training. Means with a 95% interval over the splits.
limits: Weak in absolute terms: modestly better than chance at regularity, and duration explains under a fifth of the variance.
69 people with a Fitbit Sense (35 under 30, 31 aged 30 or over, 3 not given), May 2021 to January 2022: it may not describe you.
Nothing it predicts was ever about alarms: no public dataset records an alarm, a snooze or a wake check.
Screen time, caffeine, room noise and temperature can't move these predictions: no dataset recorded them.
